title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for pressure ulcer.

HPI
The patient is an 88-year-old woman presenting for a follow-up evaluation of a pressure ulcer located over the sacrum. She reports that the area has been causing discomfort but she has been diligent with her dressing changes at home. She notes that the skin remains intact around the edges of the wound but she desires a professional assessment of the healing progress.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Amlodipine 5mg daily
Atorvastatin 20mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Physical examination of the skin reveals a stage 3 pressure ulcer over the sacrum. The wound bed shows granulation tissue with moderate drainage. The surrounding skin is intact and shows no signs of maceration. Peripheral pulses are palpable, and the patient's vitals are stable.

Assessment
Stage 3 pressure ulcer of the sacrum.

Plan
The wound was cleansed with normal saline and a fresh dressing was applied. I instructed the patient to continue repositioning every two hours to reduce pressure on the sacrum. We will continue to monitor the stage 3 pressure ulcer during the next scheduled visit.

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: Pressure ulcer of the sacral region, stage 3: L89.153 (HCC 381).

distractors.why: The stage is documented: it decides the code and the HCC.
